reconstructed_values.carrier_envelope_note: The 8.09 x 4.078 x 3.88 m carrier values are measured limits of this independently authored partial presentation, not manufacturer dimensions. The published 3.05-4.06 m figure is wheel tread, not overall width.
reconstructed_values.selected_boom_span_note: The order guide identifies the option only as nominal 36 m (120 ft). The visible 36.20 m deployed presentation is reconstructed to contain 72 bodies at 0.508 m pitch and is not asserted as Deere tip-to-tip dimensional authority.
reconstructed_values.tank_visualization: Neutral cylindrical stainless enclosure with 4.849 m3 gross exterior volume for the published 1,200 U.S. gallon (4.542 m3) capacity; no internal volume, liquid or pressure simulation.
reconstructed_values.neutral_tread_note: Reconstructed neutral wheel-center tread lies inside the published 3.05-4.06 m hydraulic range; viewer travel is bounded to 4.018 m.
reconstructed_values.reconstructed_tire_note: Circular generic row-crop tire envelope only. No tire order code, section width, loaded radius or approved fitment is claimed.
reconstructed_values.frame_underside_note: The visible main-frame underside is authored at the published 1.47 m standard-tire crop-clearance plane; hubs, tires and suspension remain below it.
reconstructed_values.boom_section_note: Three articulated wing stages per side sum to the reconstructed 36.20 m presentation span. Section lengths, yaw pivots and transport choreography are not published.
reconstructed_values.selected_application_topology_note: Counts and 20-inch pitch are manufacturer-published for codes 5165, 4995 and 5465; mounting coordinates and visible pipe routing are reconstructed.
reconstructed_values.materials: Neutral unbranded slate, graphite, steel, rubber and glass; no logos, decals or copied trade dress.
reconstructed_values.all_animation_ranges: Bounded steering, tread, boom lift/roll and three-stage accordion-fold presentation ranges; visible steering linkage cues follow their pivots, but no Ackermann, cylinder-closure or hydraulic solution is claimed.
